get_nearest_eye_gaze: get the nearest eye gaze data point for a given timestamp in nanoseconds
get_nearest_pose: get the nearest closed or open loop trajectory pose for a given timestamp
get_nearest_hand_tracking_result: get the nearest hand tracking result for a given timestamp in nanoseconds
filter_points_from_confidence: filter a point cloud by inverse depth and depth confidence thresholds
get_gaze_vector_reprojection: project an eye gaze vector onto a camera image at a specified depth
